text.en:
The expenditure of the following sum out of the funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated is hereby authorized, in addition to the appropriation contained in Act Numbered Three thousand
JJ.- BUREAU OF POSTS
MISCELLANEOUS EXPENSES
526A. Freight, express, and delivery service, including the transportation of mail, and establishment of
telegraph and radio stations
Total of additional appropriation for the Bureau of Posts
150,000.00

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 16, 1923.
